data.notes: October 2026 is unusually stacked around Seoul, with airport-adjacent mega-festivals, Olympic Park pop festivals, and Itaewon/Hapjeong club nights running alongside major arena and stadium concerts.

events.title: EDC Korea 2026
events.summary: The Korean edition of Electric Daisy Carnival takes over INSPIRE Entertainment Resort in Incheon on October 3–4. The official lineup includes DJ Snake, Illenium B2B Dabin, Sara Landry, Subtronics, Alok, Tiësto, Fisher and more.

events.title: Hyundai Card Super Concert 28: The Weeknd
events.summary: The Weeknd headlines Hyundai Card Super Concert 28 at Goyang Stadium on October 7–8, with Creepy Nuts listed as the opening act in the official Hyundai Card announcement.

events.title: XMF (Xnterstellar Music Festival) 2026
events.summary: A large Korea–Japan live-band festival at Paradise City in Incheon, with Ado, Younha, LUCY, FTISLAND, DAY6, ONE OK ROCK, YB, Xdinary Heroes and more across two days.

events.title: Grand Mint Festival 2026
events.summary: Mint Paper’s long-running autumn pop festival returns to Olympic Park across four stages: 88 Grass Field, KSPO Dome, Ticketlink Live Arena and 88 Lakeside Stage.

events.title: 2026 GHOST Festival | Gyeonggi Hallyu OST Festival
events.summary: The three-day Hallyu OST festival near Seoul features K-drama and film OST-oriented sets, with artists including FTISLAND, YB, Heize, Gummy, Wendy, WINNER, Rain, Lee Youngji, Kim Chang-wan Band and 2am.

events.title: FENG Weekend Rockstar Asia - SEOUL
events.summary: UK artist FENG’s first Asia run lands at Cakeshop Seoul with Che, trini, Lakepine, AUS10, Unbornarnold and autopilot 77_77, positioned between hip-hop, pop and club sounds.

events.title: UNDERCITY presents Bart Skils
events.summary: Amsterdam techno mainstay Bart Skils plays an extended set at UNDERCITY, joined by Pierre Blanche, ION and Oibro.

events.title: HEARTBEAT BY DUDUDO 2026
events.summary: A two-day pop, R&B and hip-hop concert event at Korea University Hwajeong Gymnasium with The Rose, iKON, ONF, ASH ISLAND, george, ADOY, jeebanoff, Crush, Loco, Sik-K, Kid Milli, pH-1 and more listed by Melon Ticket.

events.title: Cakeshop 14th Anniversary at Cake and Pistil
events.summary: Cakeshop marks 14 years across Cakeshop and Pistil with a large local-crew bill including bloodzboi live and crews such as SOAR, More Breaks, Darklight, Kimchi Factory Homies and others.

events.title: HIGH-TECH SEOUL day of HANGUL
events.summary: HIGH-TECH SEOUL’s Hangul Day event brings D.Dan, Mari Sakurai, Hadone, E3, SINAE, Youknowsong, JAEHAN, Shinyoung and SEOD to The Opera for a techno-focused all-nighter.

events.title: Lil Louis at MODECi
events.summary: Chicago house pioneer Lil Louis headlines MODECi with Acidwork, AND 1, DJ Soulscape, Kyper, Yongmasan and Isco.

events.title: STRUGGLE PRESENTS - MIND SHOCK #001 EURO RAVE
events.summary: STRUGGLE launches MIND SHOCK with a Euro-rave concept at UNDERCITY, spanning drum & bass, free tekno, psytrance, trance, techno, UK garage, breakbeat and electro with Tanukichi and local selectors.

events.title: Cakeshop presents: Evian Christ
events.summary: Cakeshop welcomes Evian Christ back to Seoul with local support from Wona, Simo, Paola, Tabris, Moon go america and Audiogothh.

events.title: GEGEN x Faust
events.summary: Berlin queer techno party brand GEGEN teams with Faust for a Seoul edition featuring Mar/us and Cristian Marras.

events.title: 2026 Seoul Music Festival
events.summary: Seoul’s official city-backed music festival runs for one day at Nodeul Island, with a main performance lineup of Paul Kim, Kwon Jin-ah, Rooftop Moonlight, Nerd Connection, Chudahae Chagis and Kim Chang-wan Band.

events.title: Benson Boone: Wanted Man Tour in Seoul
events.summary: Benson Boone brings the Wanted Man Tour to KINTEX in Goyang for a one-night Seoul-area concert on October 26.

events.title: BRVJ presents LUNAR PALACE / 月下宫殿
events.summary: BRVJ’s first Korea event at Cakeshop pairs live sets from Yaka and Millennium with DJs Zozy, Jangma Lin, Janny, HYUNHXEE, Excultist and Mamsuuuuu, bridging Chinese club, jungle, techno, bass and Korean hip-hop contexts.

events.title: Kontra-Musik 20 Years Night
events.summary: Vurt hosts a 20th-anniversary night for Swedish underground label Kontra-Musik with Ulf Eriksson and a TM404 live set, supported by Seoul selectors.

events.title: Post Malone Presents The BIG Stadium World Tour in Seoul
events.summary: Post Malone headlines the Seoul-area stop of The BIG Stadium World Tour at Goyang Sports Complex, with Don Toliver listed as support by Live Nation Korea.

events.title: LANY: soft world tour in Korea
events.summary: LANY bring their soft world tour to KINTEX Hall 9 in the Seoul metro area for a one-night pop concert.

events.title: Gangnam Festival 2026 — Yeongdong-daero K-Pop Concert
events.summary: Seoul’s official festival listing schedules Gangnam Festival from October 2–5, with the Yeongdong-daero K-Pop Concert specifically listed for October 4. Artist lineup has not yet been published on the source page.

events.title: Charlie Puth - Whatever's Clever! World Tour in Seoul
events.summary: Charlie Puth’s Whatever's Clever! World Tour is confirmed for the Seoul metro area at Goyang Sports Complex on October 11.
